limits: peers are byte copies of one quiesced store, so they share the origin ledger identity and incarnation
the content store may gain unreferenced sealed objects during a refused import; no fact is published
no model, provider or network is involved; the authored control text is parsed by the real parser
scope: Source-level obligation partition settlement proof: real parser, Store, CAS and archive code, two independent OS processes settling from one committed origin with a rendezvous barrier, archive exchange, unit refusal, convergence, sticky terminal state, relay and reopen. Not a power-loss, distributed-installation, network, or model-efficacy proof; no provider request is made.
